{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the distribution of the 'status' column
status_counts = sales_df['status'].value_counts()

# Identify the actual completed orders
# According to the data dictionary, 'completed' means the order was successfully processed
# and not refunded
completed_orders = status_counts.get('completed', 0)

# Print the number of completed orders
completed_orders"}
